title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 Response Message Parser Work Item
summary: Add bounded DNS response parsing for RFC 9461 SVCB answers and Additional-section address hints.
planned_changes:
- Add `DnsServiceBindingResponseMessage` to parse DNS response headers, questions, answers, authority records, and Additional records.
- Decode SVCB answer RDATA through the existing AliasMode and ServiceMode parsers.
- Add `DnsServiceBindingAdditionalAddress` and `DnsServiceBindingQuestion` scalar models.
- Extract Internet-class A and AAAA Additional-section records.
- Reject malformed compression, truncation, malformed SVCB RDATA, malformed address RDATA, and trailing bytes.
- Add requirement-owned positive, negative, and edge tests.
- Update RFC 9461 trace artifacts, generated triage, and the requirement gap ledger.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused RFC 9461 response parser requirement-home tests, core SpecTrace JSON validation, QUIC requirement coverage triage generation, diff hygiene, and the full local Release solution test before final goal completion.
out_of_scope: Platform router or forwarder advertisement adapters.
completion_notes: RFC 9461 now has a trace-owned DNS response parser for SVCB answers and Additional-section address hints.
